name: cenrichment-finding
description: Lead enrichment phase 2 (prds/lead-enrichment/build-plan-phase-2.md § 2, design § 6): one record per value an enrichment tier proposes, linked to the lead or the client's Company. Additive only. No field Read-only (the application writes them all). Handoff: enrichment-finding-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.tooltipText: A value for one field, a person who runs the business, or a summary of the business.

fields.name: targetField
fields.label: Field
fields.tooltipText: For a field value: the field it would fill (website, emailAddress, phoneNumber, industry).

fields.name: currentValue
fields.label: Value when found
fields.tooltipText: What the record held when the finding was made. A finding never replaces a value already there.

fields.name: confidence
fields.label: Confidence
fields.tooltipText: Counted by the application (ruling E12): Verified means two independent facts agreed on the source page.

fields.name: findingStatus
fields.label: Status
fields.tooltipText: Applied: written without a person (a verified website or email into an empty field on a lead, ruling E14).

fields.name: runRef
fields.label: Run
fields.tooltipText: The application's run that made this finding.
